name: Teleport Ambush (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Quicken spell-like ability (teleport)

Benefit(s): When you use your Quicken Spell-Like Ability (teleport) for the first time in an encounter, your opponents are considered flat-footed against you until their next action. Creatures that are aware of this ability are immune to its effects.
